비포 애프터 사진을 보내 드리고 싶을 정도예요. 변화를 보면 믿기지 않으실 거예요.
original:
Miracles do happen!
I was skeptical at first after having tried numerous major name neck and face products. After less than a month of using the retinal skin boost serum I am a believer in miracles. My face and décolletage look amazing - especially for a 70 year old grandma. In fact I look better than a lot of 40 year olds. I get compliments from family and friends on a regular basis. Most think I’ve had Botox! I share my secret with EVERYONE so that they too can feel confident about their appearance. Thank you for making me look beautiful again.
I wish I could send you before and after photos - you won’t believe the change.

author: Amy R.
text:
[초보자도 쓰기 좋은, 피부 뒤집어지지 않는 레티날] 솔직히 레티날 제품은 각질, 건조함, 자극 얘기를 하도 많이 들어서 써 보기가 겁났어요. 피부가 예민한 편이라 몇 주씩 피부 수습하는 건 피하고 싶었거든요.
그런데 메디테라피 레티날 스킨 부스터는 정말 기분 좋은 반전이었어요.
바를 때 아주 가볍고 거의 물 같은 느낌이에요. 흡수가 빠르고 얼굴이 번들거리거나 당기지 않아요. 일주일에 몇 번 밤에 쓰기 시작했는데, 각오했던 화끈거림이나 따가움이 전혀 없었어요.
몇 주 지나니 피부결이 더 매끈해 보이고 모공도 덜 눈에 띄었어요. 피부가 전체적으로 더 정돈되고 균형 잡힌 느낌이에요. 순해서 꾸준히 쓸 수 있다는 게 좋은데, 레티노이드는 그게 제일 어렵잖아요.
레티날이 처음이거나 저처럼 자극이 걱정된다면 시작하기 정말 좋은 제품이에요. 효과는 느껴지면서도 피부에 순한데, 그 균형을 찾기가 쉽지 않거든요.
original:
Beginner-Friendly Retinal That Didn’t Wreck My Skin
I was honestly nervous to try a retinal product because I’ve heard so many stories about peeling, dryness, and irritation. My skin can be sensitive, so I didn’t want to deal with weeks of damage control.
This Meditherapy Retinal Skin Booster has been such a pleasant surprise.
It feels very lightweight and almost watery when you apply it. It absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave my face greasy or tight. I started using it a few nights a week, and I didn’t experience any burning or harsh stinging — which I was fully expecting.
After a few weeks, I noticed my skin texture looked smoother and my pores appeared less noticeable. My skin just looks more refined and balanced overall. It’s gentle enough that I can actually stick with it consistently, which is the hardest part with retinoids.
If you’re new to retinal or scared of irritation like I was, this is a really good place to start. It feels effective but still kind to the skin — and that balance is hard to find.
